title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha fakes a kitchen injury to overshadow Nila's achievement, but Chozhan sees through her act. Later, Chandayatha and Cheran leave for their honeymoon.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Bagyaraj pleads with Malar to return, but she sees through his selfish motives and realises he needs a homemaker, not a wife he loves. Standing her ground, Malar refuses to return.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi asks Mahalingam for Eshwari's call records to help free Sethupathi. The records reveal a link to Abinav, prompting her to suspect them of sabotaging the eye care camp.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: On her birthday, Pooja feels married to Aadhavan as he adorns her with a gold chain and applies Kumkum. Meanwhile, her uncle traces her location through a cake order in her name.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu annoys Kanmani by fondly calling her 'Baby' after she forbids him from using her name. Elsewhere, Vennila denies Rajeshwari financial support as her bank account is blocked.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy praises Lakshmi for improving the mess and gifts her footwear, but questions her reluctance to wear it. Meanwhile, Azhagappan taunts Shanmugam over his unpaid meal.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan visits Anjali with his baby to discuss marriage. While Thangamayil worries for the missing newborn, Anjali tells Pandian and Gomathi to take Saravanan back.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena gives her jewellery to help Muthu cover the cost of repairing a car damaged by his vehicle. Enraged, Vijaya questions Parvathy for providing space for Rohini's parlour.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sudar worries about Vetri being stranded in the rain with Sandhya, while Abinaya hugs Vetri out of fear of thunder. Meanwhile, Karna seeks bail from Divakar to exact his revenge.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar panics over Mayandi's shock, while Poongodi orders Pechi to search their home for the killer. Meenatchi and Deivanai later explain to Mayandi why Azhagar quit his studies.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Sidharth ousts Kumaresan and Ganthimathi over theft allegations while Paraman defends them. Then, Ilamathi rebukes Sidharth after he mocks Paraman for not earning money.
